description: Places a real order that Hoplix prints and ships, with the same checks and prices as an order quote. Nothing is charged: the order is created unpaid and goes into production only after the seller pays it from the Orders page of the Hoplix account (the payment link is also sent by email), unless the account has agreed billing terms. order_reference is mandatory and unique: an existing reference is never ordered twice. With test=true the order is only validated and recorded as a test (TEST-... id).

order_reference.description: The seller's own unique reference for this order (letters, digits, dot, underscore, hyphen; max 50)

product-color.description: Colour, one of the campaign product colours

product-id.description: product-id of the campaign product, as shown in the campaign details

product-size.description: Size, one of the product sizes (e.g. "M")

country-code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. IT, DE, FR)

province.description: Province code, required for Italy (e.g. MI)

test.description: true = test order: validated and priced, nothing is produced or charged

name: create_order
title: Place an order
